selection_rationale: Goal was a ~55-option authoritative skeleton. I included ALL native web-form fields because they ARE the actual form and are non-negotiable: the pre-section core_type, 6 identifiers fields (symbol, transcript_version, ccds, protein, uniprot, hgvs), 8 variants/frequency fields (check_existing + derived clinvar, var_synonyms, af, af_1kg, af_gnomade, af_gnomadg, pubmed, failed), 12 additional_annotations fields (biotype, numbers, tsl, appris, mane, canonical, distance, mirna, domains, regulatory, cell_type, gene_phenotype), 2 predictions (sift, polyphen), 7 filters (frequency, coding_only + the five mutually-exclusive Restrict-results values pick/pick_allele/per_gene/summary/most_severe), and 2 advanced (buffer_size, shift_3prime). That is 39 native/derived entries. To these I added the 18 highest-priority plugins from the plugins dossier's tier-1 list (10 predictions: cadd, revel, alphamissense, dbnsfp, clinpred, eve, spliceai, maxentscan, dbscsnv [Blosum62 deferred as lowest-value of the 10]; 2 gene-tolerance: loeuf, dosage_sensitivity; 4 functional-effect: nmd, utrannotator, paralogues, mutfunc; 2 variant-evidence: mastermind, geno2mp; phenotypes; enformer for the regulatory-impact niche) and the single most important custom dataset gnomAD_SV (covering the structural-variant/population niche). Total = 58 options, squarely on the proposal's ~55 target. Every disputed fact was verified against InputForm.pm: protein and hgvs default OFF (no 'checked' key, L409-431), the regulatory dropdown defaults to reg=Yes (L779), the five restrict-results values are a single name=summary dropdown (L348-363), core_type is a radiolist with gencode_primary in field_class tokens, and cell_type is gated by the regulatory dropdown's 'cell' value (_stt_cell, L783/791) - so cell_type depends_on regulatory. All web_form_section values are one of the six canonical CONFIG_SECTIONS ids (core_type and buffer_size/shift_3prime mapped to 'advanced' since the transcript-db pre-section has no canonical id of its own and 'advanced' is the closest valid home). conflicts_with and depends_on reference only ids present in this list, so the constraint graph is internally consistent. I deferred ClinVar_SV, the 7 lower-priority plugins (GO, AncestralAllele, OpenTargets, IntAct, MaveDB, RiboseqORFs, Blosum62), and the AllOfUs/GENCODE_promoter customs to keep the skeleton near target while leaving a clear path to the full 26-plugin / multi-custom catalogue.
